title: VR Mindfulness for Students
description: An immersive Unity application designed to give students a short break through guided virtual environments and mindfulness activities.

images.description: A selection of guided virtual environments and mindfulness activities.

images.alt: VR application onboarding and headset guidance
images.description: In-world onboarding combines headset guidance with introductory instructions.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.text: The application was designed to support moments of mindfulness and a short break from student life through an immersive virtual environment.

sections.title: Experience
sections.text: The documented experience includes headset guidance, introductory instructions and a choice of themed environments and activities.

sections.title: Project material
sections.text: The gallery shows the environment-selection interface and onboarding. The linked video provides a closer look at the application.
